newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain buying pesetas at 84.95/DM - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain buying pesetas at 84.95/DM - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas at 84.95 per mark, dealers said on Monday.
"The Bank of Spain is buying pesetas versus the mark at 84.95. If it didn't, the peseta would be under pressure from the lira's fall," a dealer said.
The Bank of Spain declined to comment, in line with its usual policy.
The central bank, which cut its key money rate by 25 basis points to 5.75 percent on Friday, was also seen buying pesetas in the market that day at the same level.
At around 0950 GMT, right after this morning's reported intervention, the peseta was trading at around 84.93/96 per mark.
